Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) Safety Information
MR Conditional (1.5T and 3.0T): spatial field gradient ≤ 2,000 gauss/cm (20 T/m); Whole-Body SAR ≤ 1.2 W/kg; Limit total active scanning to 30 min; A cooling period of 30 minutes is required between scans.
Image artifact: up to 10 mm.
RF heating was evaluated using a body coil at 64 MHz and 128 MHz in a gel phantom.
